info.title: UK Drops Feed
info.description: Collectibles and video game release dates, prices and restocks for AI agents, covering the UK (default) plus official US, Canada, Australia/NZ, Europe, Japan and other listed regions when published: Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Star Wars: Unlimited and MTG; official TCG street-date calendar; LEGO; game launches including GTA 6; prereleases; Black Friday / Cyber Monday sale windows; curated stock/preorder status; weekly official-source briefs. Filter with region (UK default, or US, CA, AU, EU, JP, all). Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, or start with 25 free calls (POST /v1/trial-key), or buy a 25-call prepaid credit pack. Card credit packs (GBP, Stripe): GET /v1/credits/packs. A hand-checked question route returns a researched, cited answer within 24 hours (not instant, not financial advice).
info.x-guidance: Start with GET /v1/teaser (free) or mint a 25-call free trial key via POST /v1/trial-key (optional ?ref=<channel>), then pass X-Trial-Key or Authorization: Bearer on /v1/drops/* and /v1/briefs/*. After 25 calls, pay $0.01 USDC per call on Base via x402 or buy 25 calls for $0.20 via POST /v1/credits/buy. No crypto wallet? Pay by card (GBP, via Stripe): Starter £3 = 250 calls https://buy.stripe.com/14AfZj2Scb1z5BKfrmgMw00 · Builder £10 = 1,000 calls https://buy.stripe.com/00w14pcsMfhP7JScfagMw01 · Pro £25 = 3,000 calls https://buy.stripe.com/00w00lakEglT0hq5QMgMw02. Your credit key is shown on screen right after payment; credits do not expire. Pack list: GET https://uk-drops-feed.8bitbudgets.workers.dev/v1/credits/packs. Default region is UK; pass region=US, CA, AU, EU, JP or all.
